blocks.content: Quiz: A user visits /entries/1 for the first time and sees the skeleton. They navigate away and come back. What happens the second time?
Tap an option below to answer:
The app throws an error because the chunk was already imported
Importing a cached module is valid and happens transparently.
Importing a cached module is valid and happens transparently.
The skeleton shows again because lazy() always re-fetches
lazy() relies on the browser's module cache, not its own re-fetch logic.
lazy() relies on the browser's module cache, not its own re-fetch logic.
The skeleton shows for exactly 300ms as a minimum delay
<Suspense> has no built-in minimum delay. It resolves as soon as the chunk is ready.
<Suspense> has no built-in minimum delay. It resolves as soon as the chunk is ready.
The page renders immediately with no fallback because the chunk is cached
The browser caches the chunk after the first download. So, subsequent renders are synchronous.
The browser caches the chunk after the first download. So, subsequent renders are synchronous.
